blends.name: Willy Wookie OG Animation
blends.desc: Jerome Baker Designs × Toofless – Animated Trading Card Series First released in 2021, these 5 chaotic, collectible cards are back—now fully animated! Featuring Toofless’s twisted Garbage Pail Kid–style art mashed up with Jerome Baker’s legendary glass culture, this re-release celebrates the weird, wild, and wonderful.
